message.content: {"4": {"original": "The trial lasted two weeks, ending March 2, involving lawsuits from major studio", "rephrased": "The legal proceedings against the administrators of The Pirate Bay, a major file-sharing platform, concluded on March 2 after two weeks of testimony provided by representatives of major music and film studios such as Sony Music Entertainment, Warner Bros., and Columbia Pictures. During this trial, investigators successfully tracked and documented at least 33 specific copyrighted films and songs hosted on the site, establishing the concrete evidence base upon which the subsequent criminal convictions and financial penalties were built.", "summary": "Major studios provided evidence of 33 infringed works during a two-week trial that ended on March 2."}}
